messages:
Maya Chen: Customer reports huge latency and duplicate charges — single logical request spawns calls to us-west-2 and eu-west-1. They attached traces showing two completions. Any quick ideas?
Luis Ortega: Do they have hedged requests enabled in the client? Which SDK + version?
Acme Support Bot: ticket #INC-12345 linked to this thread (customer: acme-app).
Maya Chen: They say js-sdk v1.8.2, default config. Log snippet from customer: 
```
TRACE requestId=req_abc hedgedLaunch=true region=us-west-2 fallback=eu-west-1 latencyMs=520
TRACE requestId=req_abc hedgedLaunch=true region=eu-west-1 fallback=us-west-2 latencyMs=540
```
They also saw two billing lines for the same request.
Luis Ortega: Hmm. HedgedRequests + DNS round-robin can cause different regions to be hit for the hedge. If the runtime counts both as billable tokens we could double-charge.
Priya Shah: Also check token/auth path — if hedged request replays credential or session cookie it may be accepted in both regions. Is the client doing an immediate hedge (200-300ms) or exponential backoff?
Maya Chen: Customer says hedgeTriggerMs=250 in their internal wrapper (they didn't realize sdk had hedging enabled). Minimal repro they provided: 
```js
// simplified
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
client.generate({prompt: 'test', hedgedRequests: true});
```
They also show a cURL that resulted in two upstreams: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` with trace-id.
Luis Ortega: Can reproduce locally with js-sdk 1.8.2 + node fetch + DNS that rotates endpoints. Repro steps: set hedgeTriggerMs=200, run 100 requests, ~3% have hedged target in other region.
Priya Shah: Short-term mitigations for customer: 1) set hedgedRequests: false in client config, 2) set regionHint or REDWOOD_REGION env to pin requests, 3) downgrade to 1.8.1 if needed. Long-term: we should not double-bill hedged attempts that never complete or are cancelled.
Maya Chen: I've sent those steps to the customer (ticket updated). They asked for concrete curl command — included below.
```
# pin to us-west-2 via header, disable hedging on client
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Region: us-west-2" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Luis Ortega: I'll add router-side dedupe: if the same client request-id is seen and a hedge reaches another region within X ms, mark second attempt as non-billable and short-circuit. Also instrument hedged_request metric per region and add cost attribution tag.
Priya Shah: I'll file a SDK bug to make hedging opt-in (or at least opt-out via env var) and add a visible warning in the quickstart. Patch will target js-sdk v1.8.3.
oncall-bot: Created incident INC-2026-789 and paged eng-runtime.
Maya Chen: Thanks — please post PRs / links here. I'll keep customer updated: advised immediate client config changes, sent rollback option, and asked for logs with x-request-id for our repro. :thumbsup:
